# Onboarding block

> First-run setup flows.

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-ai-docs.mjs (npm run gen:ai). Do not edit by hand. -->

Install doc for the **Onboarding block** of ui-kit: 3 variants built only from ui-kit components. React >=18.2 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4.

## Instructions for the AI agent

Add the Onboarding block to this project exactly as specified here. If the user did not say which variant, ask, or install the first one.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Install these components first**, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Follow each one's doc, or run the download script below, which covers all of them:
   - `badge`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/badge.md
   - `button`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/button.md
   - `card`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/card.md
   - `checkbox`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/checkbox.md
   - `empty-state`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/empty-state.md
   - `field`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/field.md
   - `input`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/input.md
   - `accordion`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/accordion.md
   - `progress`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/progress.md
   - `onboarding-checklist`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/onboarding-checklist.md
   - `radio-group`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/radio-group.md
   - `stepper`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/stepper.md
   - `popover`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/popover.md
   - `tag-input`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/tag-input.md
3. **Shared files.** Create the files under [Shared files](#shared-files) at their exact paths (the download script covers them).
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/badge.css";
   @import "./components/button.css";
   @import "./components/card.css";
   @import "./components/checkbox.css";
   @import "./components/empty-state.css";
   @import "./components/field.css";
   @import "./components/input.css";
   @import "./components/accordion.css";
   @import "./components/progress.css";
   @import "./components/onboarding-checklist.css";
   @import "./components/radio-group.css";
   @import "./components/stepper.css";
   @import "./components/popover.css";
   @import "./components/tag-input.css";
   ```

5. **Create the block.** Save the variant verbatim as its own file, for example `components/blocks/onboarding/<variant>.tsx` inside the `@/` folder, then render it from a page. Change the copy (names, prices, links) only if the user asks.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Block: Onboarding

First-run setup for a product: a short wizard, the "getting started" home that follows it, and an optional split welcome with questions. An app block: library components (`Stepper`, `Field`, `Input`, `TagInput`, `RadioGroup`, `Checkbox`, `OnboardingChecklist`, `Card`, `Empty`, `Progress`, `Button`, `Badge`, `Icon`) plus Tailwind utilities. No new CSS.

#### Variants
```
wizard            Stepper (3 steps) + one form per step: workspace name and address · invite teammates · plan and accent → finish screen
getting-started   welcome card with trial meter | OnboardingChecklist + Deployments card (Empty state) | Quick links + help card
split-welcome     brand panel (bg-primary) | progress bar + one question at a time (radio cards, checkbox cards) → finish screen
```

#### Anatomy (wizard)
```
<section data-accent?>            @container rounded-2xl border bg-background, px 16 → 32px, py 32 → 48px
  <div>                           mx-auto max-w-2xl grid gap-8
    <header>                      logo mark (32px bg-primary, rounded-lg) + name · "Step n of 3" (13px muted, tabular)
    <Stepper value onValueChange aria-label="Workspace setup">
      <StepperItem step disabled={step > current}> Trigger > Indicator + Content(Title, Description) · Separator
    <div key={step}>              ui-animate-rise, rounded-xl border bg-card p-5 → p-8
      <form noValidate>           grid gap-6
        <h2 tabIndex=-1>          20px/600 font-display, then a 15px muted lead (max-w-prose)
        fields…
        actions                   border-t pt-5, flex wrap justify-between: Back (outline, arrow-left) | [Skip (ghost)] Continue (primary, arrow-right)
```
Steps:
1. **Workspace**: `Field required` + `Input` name (autocomplete organization). `Field required` + `InputGroup` (`InputAddon` "halcyon.app/" + `Input`) address, with `FieldHint`. The address is the slugified name until edited by hand.
2. **Team**: `Field` + `TagInput` (email `validate`, `maxTags` 10, `inputMode="email"`), `FieldHint`, `FieldError` fed by `onTagRejected`. "Invite as": horizontal `RadioGroup` Member / Admin with descriptions. Primary label becomes "Send N invites"; "Skip for now" shows only while the list is empty.
3. **Plan**: `RadioGroup variant="card" orientation="horizontal"` (Hobby $0 · Pro $20 · Team $45, name left, price right, muted). Accent: horizontal `RadioGroup` whose labels carry a 14px dot `<span data-accent={id} class="bg-primary">`; the choice is written to the section's `data-accent`, so the whole block previews it.
4. **Finish** (step 4, all stepper steps complete): `ui-stagger` column: 48px `bg-success` disc with a check and `ring-8 ring-success/15`, h2 "{name} is ready" (24px), a one-line summary, a bordered `<dl>` (Address, Invites with a role Badge, Plan) that becomes two columns from 28rem, then "Open your dashboard" (link, primary) and "Change something" (outline).

#### Anatomy (getting-started)
- Welcome `Card` (p-5 → p-8, grid, from 48rem `1fr 16rem`): eyebrow in `text-primary-text`, h2 24 → 28px, lead, Tour (primary, sparkles) + Read the docs (outline link). Trial panel: rounded-lg border bg-background p-4, "2 of 14 days", `Progress size="sm"` with `getValueText`.
- Below, from 48rem `1.6fr 1fr`. Left: controlled `OnboardingChecklist headingLevel={2}` (5 steps, each with an `xs` outline action that marks it done; `onDismiss` swaps it for a one-line "Setup finished" row with "Show checklist"), then a Deployments `Card` with `Empty variant="dashed"` whose two actions also tick checklist steps; once deployed it shows one row (icon tile, name, commit, `Badge variant="success"` Ready, "Just now"). Right: Quick links card (`<nav>` list: 32px bordered icon tile, title, one-line description, arrow-up-right) and a `Card variant="muted"` help card.

#### Anatomy (split-welcome)
- `@container overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border`; from 48rem a `5fr 7fr` grid with min-height 36rem.
- Aside: `bg-primary text-primary-foreground p-6 → p-10`, logo (inverted), h2 24 → 28px, lead at 90% opacity; the perks list (check icons) shows only from 48rem.
- Main: "Question n of 3" + "Skip for now" (link button) over a `Progress size="sm"` whose value is the number answered. Then `<form key={question}>` (ui-animate-rise): h3 question (`tabIndex=-1`, names the group), the options, an inline error (`role="alert"`, destructive text, circle-alert icon), and the Back / Continue row.
- Questions: role (`RadioGroup variant="card"`, 4 with descriptions), team size (`variant="card" orientation="horizontal"`, 4 short labels), goals (`Checkbox variant="card"` ×4 in a `role="group"`, at least one).
- Finish: success disc with sparkles, h3, the answers as rounded-full chips, "Go to dashboard" + "Edit answers".

#### Behaviour
- Validation runs on submit; after the first failed Continue, errors update as you type. Focus goes to the first invalid control.
- Workspace: name ≥ 2 characters; address `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,30}[a-z0-9]$`, and reserved names (`acme`, `halcyon`, `admin`) say "is taken".
- Invites: Enter, Tab or comma adds; an invalid address stays in the field, shows an error, and blocks Continue until fixed or cleared.
- Stepper: steps before the current one are buttons that go back (values are kept); later ones are disabled. On the finish screen all are disabled.
- When the step or question changes (not on first render), focus moves to its heading.

#### Visual rules
- Body copy left-aligned, max-w-prose; never balanced or centred. Headings `font-display`, 600, `tracking-tight`.
- One primary action per step, on the right; Back always outline on the left.
- Semantic colours only; the accent dots get their colour from a scoped `data-accent`, never palette values.
- No shadows on in-flow cards and no gradients; the only large colour fill is the split-welcome panel (`bg-primary`).

#### Motion
- Step panels and questions: `ui-animate-rise` keyed on the step. Finish screens: `ui-stagger`. Stepper line and check use the component's own spring.
- Reduced motion: content swaps in place.

#### Accessibility
- Stepper `aria-label`, `aria-current="step"`, "(completed)" on done steps. Fields wired by `Field` (label, hint, `aria-invalid`, `role="alert"` error).
- Radio and checkbox groups are named by their visible label (`aria-labelledby`) and described by the error when present.
- Progress bars and the checklist ring carry `aria-label` and a text value.

#### Responsive
- 360px: single column; the stepper shows only the current step's text; actions wrap; finish buttons stack.
- Container queries, not viewport: `@md` (28rem) summary grid and side-by-side buttons, `@2xl` (42rem) larger padding, `@3xl` (48rem) two columns.

#### Acceptance checks
- Wizard: Continue on an empty name shows the error and focuses the name; a valid name and address advances; Back returns with values kept; finishing shows "{name} is ready" with all three steps complete.
- An invalid invite address blocks Continue with an error; a valid list changes the button to "Send N invites".
- Getting started: an action or the empty-state button raises the checklist count (`aria-valuenow`); all five done shows the complete title and Dismiss.
- Split welcome: Continue with nothing picked shows the error; three answers end on the summary chips.
- No horizontal overflow at 360px; axe reports no serious violations in light and dark.

Imports are rewritten from the package to the local files (`@/ui/...`).

### First-run wizard

File: `components/blocks/onboarding/wizard.tsx` (docs source: `apps/docs/examples/blocks/onboarding/wizard.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type FormEvent, type ReactNode, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Field, FieldError, FieldHint, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { Input, InputAddon, InputGroup } from '@/ui/components/input';
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from '@/ui/components/radio-group';
import { Stepper, StepperContent, StepperDescription, StepperIndicator, StepperItem, StepperSeparator, StepperTitle, StepperTrigger } from '@/ui/components/stepper';
import { TagInput } from '@/ui/components/tag-input';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const STEPS = [
  { title: 'Workspace', description: 'Name and address' },
  { title: 'Team', description: 'Invite teammates' },
  { title: 'Plan', description: 'Plan and colour' },
];

const PLANS = [
  { id: 'hobby', name: 'Hobby', price: '$0', blurb: '1 project and 100 GB of bandwidth.' },
  { id: 'pro', name: 'Pro', price: '$20', blurb: 'Unlimited projects and preview deploys.' },
  { id: 'team', name: 'Team', price: '$45', blurb: 'Roles, single sign-on and an audit log.' },
];

const ACCENTS = [
  { id: 'neutral', name: 'Default' },
  { id: 'violet', name: 'Violet' },
  { id: 'blue', name: 'Blue' },
  { id: 'emerald', name: 'Emerald' },
  { id: 'rose', name: 'Rose' },
  { id: 'amber', name: 'Amber' },
];

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
const SLUG = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,30}[a-z0-9]$/;
const TAKEN = ['acme', 'halcyon', 'admin'];

function slugify(text: string) {
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFKD')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
    .slice(0, 32);
}

function nameError(name: string) {
  return name.trim().length < 2 ? 'Enter a workspace name of at least 2 characters.' : '';
}

function slugError(slug: string) {
  if (!SLUG.test(slug)) return 'Use 3 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen.';
  if (TAKEN.includes(slug)) return `halcyon.app/${slug} is taken. Try another address.`;
  return '';
}

export default function OnboardingWizard() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [slug, setSlug] = useState('');
  const [slugEdited, setSlugEdited] = useState(false);
  const [triedWorkspace, setTriedWorkspace] = useState(false);
  const [invites, setInvites] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [inviteRole, setInviteRole] = useState('member');
  const [inviteError, setInviteError] = useState('');
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState('pro');
  const [accent, setAccent] = useState('neutral');

  const nameRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const slugRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const inviteRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const headingRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const shownStep = useRef(step);
  const uid = useId();

  // Move focus to the new step's heading so screen readers hear where they are (not on first load)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (shownStep.current === step) return;
    shownStep.current = step;
    headingRef.current?.focus();
  }, [step]);

  const done = step > STEPS.length;
  const errors = triedWorkspace ? { name: nameError(name), slug: slugError(slug) } : { name: '', slug: '' };
  const planName = PLANS.find((p) => p.id === plan)?.name ?? 'Pro';

  const submitWorkspace = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setTriedWorkspace(true);
    if (nameError(name)) return nameRef.current?.focus();
    if (slugError(slug)) return slugRef.current?.focus();
    setStep(2);
  };

  const submitTeam = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const leftover = inviteRef.current?.value.trim();
    if (leftover) {
      setInviteError(`${leftover} is not a valid email address. Fix it or clear the field.`);
      return inviteRef.current?.focus();
    }
    setInviteError('');
    setStep(3);
  };

  const submitPlan = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setStep(4);
  };

  return (
    <section
      data-accent={accent === 'neutral' ? undefined : accent}
      className="@container rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-4 py-8 @2xl:px-8 @2xl:py-12"
    >
      <div className="mx-auto grid w-full max-w-2xl gap-8">
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5">
            <span className="grid size-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
              <Icon name="zap" size={16} />
            </span>
            <span className="truncate text-md font-semibold">Halcyon</span>
          </div>
          <p className="shrink-0 text-sm tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
            {done ? 'Setup complete' : `Step ${step} of ${STEPS.length}`}
          </p>
        </header>

        <Stepper value={step} onValueChange={setStep} aria-label="Workspace setup">
          {STEPS.map((s, i) => (
            <StepperItem key={s.title} step={i + 1} disabled={i + 1 > step || done}>
              <StepperTrigger>
                <StepperIndicator />
                <StepperContent>
                  <StepperTitle>{s.title}</StepperTitle>
                  <StepperDescription>{s.description}</StepperDescription>
                </StepperContent>
              </StepperTrigger>
              {i < STEPS.length - 1 && <StepperSeparator />}
            </StepperItem>
          ))}
        </Stepper>

        <div key={step} className="ui-animate-rise min-w-0 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5 @2xl:p-8">
          {step === 1 && (
            <form noValidate onSubmit={submitWorkspace} className="grid gap-6">
              <StepHeading headingRef={headingRef} title="Create your workspace">
                A workspace holds your projects, deploys and team. You can rename it later.
              </StepHeading>
              <Field required>
                <Label>Workspace name</Label>
                <Input
                  ref={nameRef}
                  value={name}
                  autoComplete="organization"
                  placeholder="Northwind Labs"
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setName(e.target.value);
                    if (!slugEdited) setSlug(slugify(e.target.value));
                  }}
                />
                <FieldError>{errors.name}</FieldError>
              </Field>
              <Field required>
                <Label>Workspace address</Label>
                <InputGroup>
                  <InputAddon>halcyon.app/</InputAddon>
                  <Input
                    ref={slugRef}
                    value={slug}
                    placeholder="northwind-labs"
                    autoCapitalize="none"
                    spellCheck={false}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setSlug(e.target.value.toLowerCase());
                      setSlugEdited(true);
                    }}
                  />
                </InputGroup>
                <FieldHint>Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Teammates use it to sign in.</FieldHint>
                <FieldError>{errors.slug}</FieldError>
              </Field>
              <StepActions>
                <Button type="submit">
                  Continue
                  <Icon name="arrow-right" />
                </Button>
              </StepActions>
            </form>
          )}

          {step === 2 && (
            <form noValidate onSubmit={submitTeam} className="grid gap-6">
              <StepHeading headingRef={headingRef} title="Invite your teammates">
                They get an email with a link to join {name.trim() || 'your workspace'}. Invites expire after 7 days.
              </StepHeading>
              <Field>
                <Label>Email addresses</Label>
                <TagInput
                  ref={inviteRef}
                  value={invites}
                  onValueChange={(next) => {
                    setInvites(next);
                    setInviteError('');
                  }}
                  onTagRejected={(tag, reason, message) =>
                    setInviteError(
                      reason === 'duplicate'
                        ? `${tag} is already on the list.`
                        : reason === 'max'
                          ? 'You can invite up to 10 people now, and more from Settings later.'
                          : (message ?? `${tag} is not a valid email address.`),
                    )
                  }
                  validate={(tag) => EMAIL.test(tag) || `${tag} is not a valid email address.`}
                  maxTags={10}
                  inputMode="email"
                  placeholder={invites.length ? 'Add another' : 'name@company.com'}
                  name="invites"
                />
                <FieldHint>Press Enter or comma to add. Paste a list to add several at once.</FieldHint>
                <FieldError>{inviteError}</FieldError>
              </Field>
              <div className="grid gap-3">
                <p id={`${uid}-invite-role-label`} className="text-sm font-medium">
                  Invite as
                </p>
                <RadioGroup
                  orientation="horizontal"
                  value={inviteRole}
                  onValueChange={setInviteRole}
                  name="invite-role"
                  aria-labelledby={`${uid}-invite-role-label`}
                >
                  <RadioGroupItem value="member" label="Member" description="Can deploy and edit projects." />
                  <RadioGroupItem value="admin" label="Admin" description="Also manages billing and people." />
                </RadioGroup>
              </div>
              <StepActions onBack={() => setStep(1)}>
                {invites.length === 0 && (
                  <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setStep(3)}>
                    Skip for now
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button type="submit">
                  {invites.length === 0 ? 'Continue' : `Send ${invites.length} ${invites.length === 1 ? 'invite' : 'invites'}`}
                  <Icon name="arrow-right" />
                </Button>
              </StepActions>
            </form>
          )}

          {step === 3 && (
            <form noValidate onSubmit={submitPlan} className="grid gap-6">
              <StepHeading headingRef={headingRef} title="Pick a plan and a colour">
                Every paid plan starts with a 14-day trial. No card needed until it ends.
              </StepHeading>
              <div className="grid gap-3">
                <p id={`${uid}-plan-label`} className="text-sm font-medium">
                  Plan
                </p>
                <RadioGroup
                  variant="card"
                  orientation="horizontal"
                  value={plan}
                  onValueChange={setPlan}
                  name="plan"
                  aria-labelledby={`${uid}-plan-label`}
                >
                  {PLANS.map((p) => (
                    <RadioGroupItem
                      key={p.id}
                      value={p.id}
                      label={
                        <span className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
                          {p.name}
                          <span className="font-normal tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{p.price}/mo</span>
                        </span>
                      }
                      description={p.blurb}
                    />
                  ))}
                </RadioGroup>
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-3">
                <p id={`${uid}-accent-label`} className="text-sm font-medium">
                  Accent colour
                </p>
                <RadioGroup
                  orientation="horizontal"
                  value={accent}
                  onValueChange={setAccent}
                  name="accent"
                  aria-labelledby={`${uid}-accent-label`}
                  aria-describedby={`${uid}-accent-hint`}
                >
                  {ACCENTS.map((a) => (
                    <RadioGroupItem
                      key={a.id}
                      value={a.id}
                      label={
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span
                            aria-hidden="true"
                            data-accent={a.id === 'neutral' ? undefined : a.id}
                            className="size-3.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-primary"
                          />
                          {a.name}
                        </span>
                      }
                    />
                  ))}
                </RadioGroup>
                <p id={`${uid}-accent-hint`} className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Used for buttons, links and selected items. This page previews it as you choose.
                </p>
              </div>
              <StepActions onBack={() => setStep(2)}>
                <Button type="submit">
                  Finish setup
                  <Icon name="check" />
                </Button>
              </StepActions>
            </form>
          )}

          {done && (
            <div className="ui-stagger grid justify-items-start gap-5">
              <span className="grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-full bg-success text-success-foreground ring-8 ring-success/15">
                <Icon name="check" size={24} strokeWidth={2.5} />
              </span>
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <h2 ref={headingRef} tabIndex={-1} className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight outline-none">
                  {name.trim() || 'Your workspace'} is ready
                </h2>
                <p className="max-w-prose text-md text-muted-foreground">
                  {invites.length > 0
                    ? `We sent ${invites.length} ${invites.length === 1 ? 'invite' : 'invites'}. `
                    : 'You can invite your team any time from Settings. '}
                  {plan === 'hobby' ? 'You are on the free Hobby plan.' : `Your ${planName} trial runs until December 9.`}
                </p>
              </div>
              <dl className="grid w-full gap-x-6 gap-y-3 rounded-lg border border-border p-4 text-sm @md:grid-cols-[auto_1fr]">
                <SummaryRow term="Address">
                  <span className="break-all">halcyon.app/{slug}</span>
                </SummaryRow>
                <SummaryRow term="Invites">
                  {invites.length > 0 ? (
                    <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      {invites.length} pending
                      <Badge variant="secondary" size="sm">
                        {inviteRole === 'admin' ? 'Admins' : 'Members'}
                      </Badge>
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    'None yet'
                  )}
                </SummaryRow>
                <SummaryRow term="Plan">{plan === 'hobby' ? 'Hobby, free' : `${planName}, 14-day trial`}</SummaryRow>
              </dl>
              <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2.5 @md:flex-row">
                <Button asChild>
                  <a href="#">
                    Open your dashboard
                    <Icon name="arrow-right" />
                  </a>
                </Button>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setStep(3)}>
                  Change something
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function StepHeading({
  headingRef,
  title,
  children,
}: {
  headingRef: RefObject<HTMLHeadingElement | null>;
  title: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-1.5">
      <h2 ref={headingRef} tabIndex={-1} className="font-display text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight outline-none">
        {title}
      </h2>
      <p className="max-w-prose text-md text-muted-foreground">{children}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function StepActions({ onBack, children }: { onBack?: () => void; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-border pt-5">
      {onBack ? (
        <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onBack}>
          <Icon name="arrow-left" />
          Back
        </Button>
      ) : (
        <span />
      )}
      <div className="ml-auto flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SummaryRow({ term, children }: { term: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <>
      <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{term}</dt>
      <dd className="min-w-0 font-medium">{children}</dd>
    </>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';

import { Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const QUICK_LINKS: { title: string; description: string; icon: IconName }[] = [

];

export default function OnboardingGettingStarted() {

  const finish = (...ids: string[]) => setDone((d) => [...d, ...ids.filter((id) => !d.includes(id))]);
  const deployed = done.includes('deploy');

  const action = (label: string, ...ids: string[]) => (
    <Button size="xs" variant="outline" onClick={() => finish(...ids)}>
      {label}
    </Button>

  return (
    <section className="@container rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-4 py-8 @2xl:px-8 @2xl:py-10">
      <div className="mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl gap-6">

                steps={[

                    <EmptyActions>

          <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-6">

                  <Icon name="calendar" />
                  Book a call
                </Button>
              </div>
            </Card>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function QuickLink({ title, description, icon }: { title: string; description: ReactNode; icon: IconName }) {
  return (
    <li>
      <a
        href="#"
        className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg p-2 transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/45"
      >
        <span className="grid size-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md border border-border bg-background">
          <Icon name={icon} />
        </span>
        <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1 gap-0.5">
          <span className="text-sm font-medium">{title}</span>
          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</span>
        </span>
        <Icon name="arrow-up-right" className="mt-1 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
      </a>
    </li>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Checkbox } from '@/ui/components/checkbox';
import { Progress } from '@/ui/components/progress';
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from '@/ui/components/radio-group';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const ROLES = [
  { id: 'engineering', label: 'Engineering', description: 'I build and ship code.' },
  { id: 'design', label: 'Design', description: 'I prototype and own the design system.' },
  { id: 'product', label: 'Product', description: 'I plan releases and track impact.' },
  { id: 'operations', label: 'Operations', description: 'I keep production healthy.' },
];

const TEAM_SIZES = [
  { id: 'solo', label: 'Just me' },
  { id: 'small', label: '2 to 10' },
  { id: 'medium', label: '11 to 50' },
  { id: 'large', label: '51 or more' },
];

const GOALS = [
  { id: 'deploy', label: 'Deploy an app', description: 'Ship a project from Git in a few minutes.' },
  { id: 'previews', label: 'Preview every pull request', description: 'A live link for each branch, for review.' },
  { id: 'monitor', label: 'Monitor errors', description: 'Alerts when a release breaks something.' },
  { id: 'oncall', label: 'Set up on-call', description: 'Rotations, escalations and paging.' },
];

const QUESTIONS = ['What best describes your work?', 'How big is your team?', 'What do you want to do first?'];

const PERKS = [
  'A dashboard arranged around your role',
  'Starter templates that match your stack',
  'Sensible alert defaults for your team size',
];

export default function OnboardingSplitWelcome() {
  const [question, setQuestion] = useState(1);
  const [role, setRole] = useState('');
  const [teamSize, setTeamSize] = useState('');
  const [goals, setGoals] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const uid = useId();
  const headingRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const groupRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const shownStep = useRef(question);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (shownStep.current === question) return;
    shownStep.current = question;
    headingRef.current?.focus();
  }, [question]);

  const total = QUESTIONS.length;
  const done = question > total;
  const answered = Math.min(question - 1, total);
  const questionId = `${uid}-question`;
  const errorId = `${uid}-error`;

  const go = (next: number) => {
    setError('');
    setQuestion(next);
  };

  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const missing =
      (question === 1 && !role) || (question === 2 && !teamSize)
        ? 'Choose one option to continue.'
        : question === 3 && goals.length === 0
          ? 'Pick at least one so we know where to start.'
          : '';
    if (missing) {
      setError(missing);
      groupRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input')?.focus();
      return;
    }
    go(question + 1);
  };

  const summary = [
    ROLES.find((r) => r.id === role)?.label,
    teamSize === 'solo' ? 'Solo' : teamSize ? `${TEAM_SIZES.find((t) => t.id === teamSize)?.label} people` : undefined,
    ...goals.map((g) => GOALS.find((x) => x.id === g)?.label),
  ].filter(Boolean) as string[];

  return (
    <section className="@container overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background">
      <div className="grid @3xl:min-h-[36rem] @3xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,5fr)_minmax(0,7fr)]">
        <aside className="grid content-between gap-8 bg-primary p-6 text-primary-foreground @2xl:p-10">
          <div className="grid gap-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-primary-foreground text-primary">
                <Icon name="zap" size={16} />
              </span>
              <span className="text-md font-semibold">Halcyon</span>
            </div>
            <div className="grid gap-3">
              <h2 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight @2xl:text-3xl">
                Welcome aboard, Amina. Let&apos;s tailor Halcyon to your team.
              </h2>
              <p className="max-w-md text-md text-primary-foreground/90">
                Three quick questions. Your answers only shape what you see first; nothing is locked in.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <ul className="hidden gap-3 text-sm @3xl:grid">
            {PERKS.map((perk) => (
              <li key={perk} className="flex items-start gap-2.5 text-primary-foreground/90">
                <Icon name="check" size={16} strokeWidth={2.25} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                {perk}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </aside>

        <div className="grid min-w-0 content-start gap-8 p-5 @2xl:p-10">
          <div className="grid gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 text-sm">
              <span className="font-medium tabular-nums">
                {done ? 'All done' : `Question ${question} of ${total}`}
              </span>
              {!done && (
                <Button variant="link" size="sm" className="h-auto px-0" onClick={() => go(total + 1)}>
                  Skip for now
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
            <Progress
              value={done ? total : answered}
              max={total}
              size="sm"
              aria-label="Personalisation progress"
              getValueText={(v, m) => `${v} of ${m} questions answered`}
            />
          </div>

          {done ? (
            <div key="done" className="ui-stagger grid justify-items-start gap-5">
              <span className="grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-full bg-success text-success-foreground ring-8 ring-success/15">
                <Icon name="sparkles" size={22} />
              </span>
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <h3 ref={headingRef} tabIndex={-1} className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight outline-none">
                  Your workspace is tailored
                </h3>
                <p className="max-w-prose text-md text-muted-foreground">
                  {summary.length > 0
                    ? 'We arranged your dashboard around what you told us. Change it any time in Settings, Personalisation.'
                    : 'We kept the standard dashboard. You can personalise it any time in Settings.'}
                </p>
              </div>
              {summary.length > 0 && (
                <ul className="flex flex-wrap gap-2" aria-label="Your answers">
                  {summary.map((item) => (
                    <li key={item} className="rounded-full border border-border bg-card px-3 py-1 text-sm">
                      {item}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
              <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2.5 @md:flex-row">
                <Button asChild>
                  <a href="#">
                    Go to dashboard
                    <Icon name="arrow-right" />
                  </a>
                </Button>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => go(1)}>
                  Edit answers
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form key={question} noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="ui-animate-rise grid gap-6">
              <h3
                ref={headingRef}
                id={questionId}
                tabIndex={-1}
                className="font-display text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight outline-none"
              >
                {QUESTIONS[question - 1]}
              </h3>

              <div ref={groupRef} className="grid gap-3">
                {question === 1 && (
                  <RadioGroup
                    variant="card"
                    value={role}
                    onValueChange={(v) => {
                      setRole(v);
                      setError('');
                    }}
                    name="role"
                    invalid={!!error}
                    aria-labelledby={questionId}
                    aria-describedby={error ? errorId : undefined}
                  >
                    {ROLES.map((r) => (
                      <RadioGroupItem key={r.id} value={r.id} label={r.label} description={r.description} />
                    ))}
                  </RadioGroup>
                )}

                {question === 2 && (
                  <RadioGroup
                    variant="card"
                    orientation="horizontal"
                    value={teamSize}
                    onValueChange={(v) => {
                      setTeamSize(v);
                      setError('');
                    }}
                    name="team-size"
                    invalid={!!error}
                    aria-labelledby={questionId}
                    aria-describedby={error ? errorId : undefined}
                  >
                    {TEAM_SIZES.map((t) => (
                      <RadioGroupItem key={t.id} value={t.id} label={t.label} />
                    ))}
                  </RadioGroup>
                )}

                {question === 3 && (
                  <div
                    role="group"
                    aria-labelledby={questionId}
                    aria-describedby={error ? errorId : undefined}
                    className="grid gap-2"
                  >
                    {GOALS.map((g) => (
                      <Checkbox
                        key={g.id}
                        variant="card"
                        name="goals"
                        value={g.id}
                        checked={goals.includes(g.id)}
                        invalid={!!error}
                        onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                          setGoals((list) => (checked ? [...list, g.id] : list.filter((x) => x !== g.id)));
                          setError('');
                        }}
                        label={g.label}
                        description={g.description}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {error && (
                  <p id={errorId} role="alert" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-destructive-text">
                    <Icon name="circle-alert" size={14} />
                    {error}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-border pt-5">
                {question > 1 ? (
                  <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => go(question - 1)}>
                    <Icon name="arrow-left" />
                    Back
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  <span />
                )}
                <Button type="submit" className="ml-auto">
                  {question === total ? 'Finish' : 'Continue'}
                  <Icon name={question === total ? 'check' : 'arrow-right'} />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## Shared files

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```
